meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把任务拆成分阶段实施计划:先派人查文档和示例,弄清真实可用的 API,再写出每一步要做什么、照哪个文件做、怎么验证,并提醒别用文档里没有的接口。产出是一份可直接执行的计划。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实现时触发,尤其准备用 do 去执行之前。若计划源于 bug 或积压任务,它会让 oh-my-issues 先做归类。

say.text: 帮我规划一个用户注册功能,先查文档再给分阶段实施计划。
say.note: Claude 会先做文档发现,再输出分阶段计划。

say.text: 为支付模块重构写一份实施计划,每步标明要复制的文件和验证方式。
say.note: 计划会包含文档出处、验证清单和防错提醒。

say.text: 先别写代码,为数据库迁移制定多阶段计划,注明 API 出处。
say.note: 计划会基于查到的文档而非猜测来编写。

howto.what_en: Before planning, Claude inspects docs via subagents, then splits the task into phases. Each phase names exact sources to copy from, verification steps, and anti-patterns like invented APIs. Final output is an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to plan a feature, task, or multi-step work, especially before using do. For bug/backlog plans, oh-my-issues runs first to cluster by root cause.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for user registration; check docs first.
say_en.note: It runs doc discovery first, then outputs the plan.

say_en.text: Plan the payment module refactor: cite files per step and include verification.
say_en.note: The plan will include doc references, checks, and guards.

say_en.text: Do not code yet. Make a multi-phase migration plan with doc references.
say_en.note: The plan will be based on researched docs, not guesses.
